facts: Clinical signs continued from preceding calf respiratory disease include nasal discharges and stunted growth.
Treatment and management of respiratory illness include antibiotic therapy for bacterial infections.
Management practices for calf disease control include isolating the sick animal, reducing overcrowding, replacing bedding regularly, and ensuring proper ventilation.
Septicemia is defined as an infection of the blood.
Clinical signs of septicemia include fever, stunted growth, inappetence, lethargy, and sudden death.
Common diseases in heifers and cows include Ephemeral Fever, which is also known as 3 days sickness.
Clinical signs of Ephemeral Fever (3 days sickness) include fever, drooling, and becoming recumbent.
